name: hintlint-m5-fixture-benchmark
description: Fixture-backed benchmark used to validate the public evidence pipeline before scanning external MCP servers.

methodology.scope: Local source-available fixtures. This is a reproducibility harness, not an ecosystem prevalence claim.
methodology.evidence_policy: Only source-backed findings are counted as annotation drift or unsafe-flow evidence.

servers.name: TypeScript MCP annotation fixture
servers.description: Covers TypeScript read-only drift, external side effects, additive writes, and unsupported dynamic tool registration.

expected.notes: Expected to emit false readOnlyHint and false openWorldHint findings.

servers.name: Python MCP unsafe flow fixture
servers.description: Covers Python process execution and filesystem write flows from MCP parameters.

expected.notes: Expected to emit process and filesystem unsafe-flow findings.

servers.name: Python MCP taint and validation fixture
servers.description: Covers query, URL, connection-string, validator, and validation-asymmetry cases.

expected.notes: Expected to emit query, URL, connection-string, annotation drift, and validation-asymmetry findings.

servers.name: TypeScript MCP source evidence fixture
servers.description: Covers HTTP mutation, cloud destructive calls, process execution, URL construction, and project-level evidence.

expected.notes: Expected to emit destructive hint, process, open-world, and URL flow findings.
